data.display_address: Seagate Building 1, Seagate, Mina Rashid, Dubai
data.long_description:
Provident is proud to present to you this brand new 3-bedroom luxury residence at Seagate Rashid Yachts & Marina.

The living/dining area offers stunning SEA VIEWS and views of the 500-meter-long canal pool (swimming pool). The floor to ceiling windows let in tons of natural daylight, giving the apartment the absolute WoW factor.

The master bedroom features a private balcony and private ensuite bathroom for that extra luxury you deserve.

The apartment has an extra storage room (1.9 m X 1.4 m), convenient for storage of suitcases or any other items.

The apartment:

-Full Sea View
-3 bedroom (brand new)
-1,650 sq.ft (153 sq.m)
-3 bath
-Laundry room
-Extra storage room (1.9 m x 1.4 m)
-2 basement parking included
-Kitchen appliances included

Amenities:

-50 meters from seaside promenade
-500-meter canal pool
-Gym
-24/7 reception & security
-Residence lounge
-Spinneys supermarket on ground floor
-Café`s & restaurants within walking distance

Location

-10 min to La Mer/Jumeirah
-10 min to Downtown/DIFC
-15 min to DXB airport

Rashid Yachts & Marina is a waterfront development with its own marina and also features a 500-meter swimming pool for residents. The community has a a variety of restaurants & cafés, offices and much more. And is only a 10-minute drive from the Dubai Mall and La Mer/Jumeirah.

You need a little bit of Rashid Yachts & Marina in your life, Discover Dubai your way at Seagate Rashid Yachts & Marina.
